bio: Situated at an elevation of approximately 1 500m above sea level, this restaurant is just 250m away from Hérémence's high-speed lift station. The breathtaking mountain vistas are undoubtedly one of the restaurant's standout features, best enjoyed on the fantastic terrace. Alternatively, you can savour the view from indoors, where the atmosphere is modern and relaxed. Incidentally, the numerous decorative works of art are available for purchase. This restaurant's commitment to sustainability and its strong attachment to the region are evident in the selection of produce, such as fillet of Swiss grass-fed ox or cheese. The short wine list features labels from the region....
